hints: `smallest` has to answer in constant time, so it cannot scan. That means the answer has to already be sitting somewhere when the call arrives.
The smallest value changes only when you push or pop. Whatever you store has to survive a pop that removes the current minimum — so remembering a single number is not enough.
Keep a second stack alongside the first. Its top is always the smallest value among the elements currently in the stack.
On push, store `min(value, previous top of the min stack)`. On pop, pop both stacks. Every operation is then a handful of constant-time list operations.
